-- LOCAL-ONLY, PARTIAL CANDIDATE. Never deploy as a complete fence:
-- review_decisions and its backfill/direct writers are NOT covered.
-- No bytea decision, funding, application grant, flag or reader is enabled.
-- While the common head is not implemented, a 750 plan blocks review events,
-- provisions and 680 revisions for the record; this is not a full inventory.
-- Type conversions to/from Conveni under REPEATABLE READ fail while 730 is
-- enabled; other contention or compatibility effects remain possible.
create schema conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate;
revoke all on schema conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;

-- The legacy fence already locks both OLD/NEW source rows in UUID order.
-- Refuse installation if it is missing or disabled; trigger names below run
-- after it. A plan is only creatable for financing_type='conveni'.
do $$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger where tgrelid='public.conveni_review_events'::regclass and tgname='conveni_independent_fence_reviews' and tgenabled='O' and not tgisinternal
   and tgfoid='conveni_independent_experiment.fence_legacy_write()'::regprocedure and tgtype=31 and tgqual is null and tgattr::text='')
  or not exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger where tgrelid='public.service_provisions'::regclass and tgname='conveni_independent_fence_provisions' and tgenabled='O' and not tgisinternal
   and tgfoid='conveni_independent_experiment.fence_legacy_write()'::regprocedure and tgtype=31 and tgqual is null and tgattr::text='')
  then raise exception 'CONVENI_BYTES_EXISTING_FENCE_MISSING';end if;
 if exists(select 1 from conveni_transactional_bytes_candidate.plans p join public.source_records r on r.id=p.record_id where r.financing_type is distinct from 'conveni')
  then raise exception 'CONVENI_BYTES_PLAN_TYPE_INCONSISTENT';end if;
end $$;

create function conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_record(p_record uuid) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog as $$
declare kind_ text; enabled_ boolean;
begin
 if p_record is null then return;end if;
 -- Reacquire in the same order as the existing fence. This is necessary on
 -- the independent revisions table and protects against an earlier BEFORE
 -- trigger changing NEW.source_record_id on either legacy table.
 select financing_type::text into kind_ from public.source_records where id=p_record for update nowait;
 if not found then raise exception 'CONVENI_BYTES_SOURCE_MISSING';end if;
 if kind_ is distinct from 'conveni' then return;end if;
 -- Synchronize with 730 enable/disable. NOWAIT avoids lock-order deadlocks
 -- when an operator holds config while waiting for this source record.
 select enabled into enabled_ from conveni_preparation_guard_candidate.config where singleton for share nowait;
 if coalesce(enabled_,true) then perform conveni_preparation_guard_candidate.require_read_committed();end if;
 if exists(select 1 from conveni_transactional_bytes_candidate.plans where record_id=p_record) then
  raise exception 'CONVENI_BYTES_LEGACY_WRITER_BLOCKED' using errcode='40001';end if;
end $$;

create function conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_economic_write() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog as $$
declare old_ uuid;new_ uuid;rec_ uuid;
begin
 if tg_op<>'INSERT' then old_:=old.source_record_id;end if;
 if tg_op<>'DELETE' then new_:=new.source_record_id;end if;
 for rec_ in select distinct x from unnest(array[old_,new_]) x where x is not null order by x loop
  perform conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_record(rec_);
 end loop;
 if tg_op='DELETE' then return old;end if;return new;
end $$;

-- UPDATE locks its source row before executing this trigger, serializing a
-- type change with plan capture. Non-Conveni type changes are unchanged.
create function conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_type_change() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog as $$
declare enabled_ boolean;
begin
 if old.financing_type is not distinct from new.financing_type
  or (old.financing_type is distinct from 'conveni' and new.financing_type is distinct from 'conveni') then return new;end if;
 select enabled into enabled_ from conveni_preparation_guard_candidate.config where singleton for share nowait;
 if coalesce(enabled_,true) then perform conveni_preparation_guard_candidate.require_read_committed();end if;
 if exists(select 1 from conveni_transactional_bytes_candidate.plans where record_id=old.id) then
  raise exception 'CONVENI_BYTES_TYPE_CHANGE_BLOCKED' using errcode='40001';end if;
 return new;
end $$;
revoke all on all functions in schema conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;

create trigger zzzz_conveni_bytea_review_fence before insert or update or delete on public.conveni_review_events
 for each row execute function conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_economic_write();
create trigger zzzz_conveni_bytea_provision_fence before insert or update or delete on public.service_provisions
 for each row execute function conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_economic_write();
create trigger zzzz_conveni_bytea_revision_fence before insert on conveni_independent_experiment.revisions
 for each row execute function conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_economic_write();
-- The earlier classification trigger can change NEW.financing_type when an
-- import updates source_dataset/title rather than mentioning financing_type.
create trigger zzzz_conveni_bytea_type_fence before update on public.source_records
 for each row execute function conveni_bytea_legacy_fence_candidate.guard_type_change();
